ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $C$ is a point on line segment $AB$, and $D$ and $E$ are the midpoints of line segments $AC$ and $BC$, respectively. If $AB = 10$ and $AD = 2$, find the length of $CE$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $D$ is the midpoint of line segment $AC$,\\
$AD=2$,\\
therefore $AC=2AD=4$,\\
since $AB=10$,\\
therefore $BC=10-4=6$,\\
since $E$ is the midpoint of line segment $BC$,\\
therefore $CE=\frac{1}{2}BC=\boxed{3}$
